text: いっていの　けいけんちを　こえると　ポケモンは　レベルが　あがり　つよく　なります。

structure.jp: いっていの　けいけんちを　こえると
structure.en: when it passes a certain amount of experience points

structure.jp: ポケモンは　レベルが　あがり
structure.en: the Pokémon's level goes up and

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says 'whenever this happens, that follows'. こえると = 'when it passes'.

patterns.name: 〜ます形 (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut short like this (あがります without ます) means 'and', joining to what comes next; it sounds written. レベルが　あがり = 'the level goes up, and'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く and adding なる says something becomes that way. つよく　なります = 'it becomes strong'.
